description: Discover the best hotels in Florence, Italy. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Florence Design Hotel in Historic Santa Maria Novella District with Three Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: Step into a world where literature meets design at 25hours Hotel Piazza San Paolino, a boldly eclectic stay in Florence’s Santa Maria Novella district. Inspired by Dante’s Divine Comedy, the hotel offers a playful contrast of 'Paradiso' and 'Inferno'-themed rooms, creating a truly one-of-a-kind experience. Savour Tuscan flavours at the lively CECCHINI IN CITTÀ restaurant, enjoy a classic Negroni at the bar and wind down with a curated screening at Cinema Paradiso.

hotels.title: Elegant Five-Star Tuscan Retreat with Michelin-Starred Restaurant
hotels.description: Escape to the rolling hills of Tuscany with a dreamy five-star stay at COMO Castello Del Nero, a breathtaking 12th-century castle draped with Renaissance frescoes. Wake up in elegant Italian style each morning and enjoy the quintessential Tuscan scenery straight from a fairy tale. This pristine retreat is located 40 minutes from Florence and is the gateway to the region’s world-class Chianti vineyards and olive groves dotted across the hilltops. Indulge at the COMO Shambhala Retreat, where the bespoke treatments induce deep relaxation and restore balance to the mind, body and soul. Bask by the turquoise pool, before embarking on a culinary journey at the Michelin-starred La Torre restaurant, which uses local produce to enhance the authentic flavours and spirit of the region.

hotels.title: 16th-Century Florentine Elegance Steps from the Duomo with Restaurant & Wine Bar
hotels.description: Discover the heart of Florence from the stylish Cerretani Hotel Firenze - MGallery Collection, where historic elegance meets contemporary flair. Housed in a carefully restored 16th-century mansion, just steps from the Duomo and Basilica of Santa Maria Novella, this boutique hotel blends Florentine charm with modern touches. Start your day with Italian pastries at the light-filled Ristorante Il Patio then step outside to explore Florence’s famed art, fashion and dining scenes - from the Uffizi Gallery to the elegant boutiques along Via de’ Tornabuoni. When evening falls, return for a glass of Tuscan wine at Il Michelangelo Bar and unwind in your serene sanctuary in the city’s historic heart.

hotels.title: Tranquil Florentine Elegance with Outdoor Pool & Onsite Restaurant
hotels.description: Discover the tranquil charm of Hotel Indigo Florence, an IHG Hotel, located in a vibrant Italian neighborhood just 10 minutes from the historic city centre. Explore the neighborhood's centuries-old history, including treasures like the Basilica of Santa Maria Novella and the world's oldest pharmacy, Officina Profumo Farmaceutica. Indulge in the best of Tuscan gastronomy at the Binomio Florence restaurant and terrace, while the lush garden with a pool invites you to enjoy breakfast or local wine.

hotels.vendor_name: Palazzo Firenze by Baglioni Hotels & Resorts
hotels.title: Five-Star Relais & Châteaux Property in the Heart of Florence with Michelin-Starred Restaurant
hotels.description: Experience the epitome of Italian elegance with an unforgettable stay at Palazzo Firenze by Baglioni Hotels & Resorts - a Relais & Châteaux and The Leading Hotels of the World property, moments from Florence's most iconic landmarks. Framed by a noble 18th-century palazzo, this five-star hotel places first-class facilities at your fingertips. Step through the historic facade and sip signature Italian tipples at the award-winning onsite winery, then indulge in delicious cuisine across your choice of exceptional restaurants including one of Italy's most famed eateries - Enoteca Pinchiorri - home to three Michelin stars. Wander onto the charming Florentine streets and explore a world of gourmet indulgence, from truffle hunts to wine tastings, and admire historic icons including the breathtaking Basilica of Santa Croce, the largest Franciscan church in the world, a less than five-minute stroll from your doorstep.
